import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class C_4_Variant3 {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        System.setIn(new ByteArrayInputStream(System.in.readAllBytes()));
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        
        // The problem is about finding the size of maximum matching in a trie of all correct bracket sequences of length 2n
        // This is equivalent to finding the number of nodes at odd levels in the trie (for maximum matching in a tree)
        // For bracket sequences, the trie structure corresponds to Catalan triangle
        // The answer is the sum of binomial coefficients C(n, k) where k is odd, which equals 2^(n-1) for n >= 1
        
        if (n == 0) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        
        long MOD = 1000000007;
        long result = 1;
        
        // Compute 2^(n-1) mod (10^9 + 7)
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            result = (result * 2) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
